mechanism.claim: When BTC spot and perpetual close a five-minute auction in the same direction but the perpetual's absolute return exceeds spot by a causal extreme amount, leverage has amplified rather than discovered the cash move. During elevated BTC variation, fade the common direction for eight hours as the leverage-only displacement mean reverts.
mechanism.side: opposite the common strict spot and perpetual return sign
mechanism.why_distinct: Spot displacement dominance follows repeated multi-hour cash-over-leverage return dominance. Basis and error-correction use price-level spreads. HVLOWR uses high/low excursion rejection with cash nonconfirmation. HVLDAR uses only the same-direction close-to-open return magnitude excess of the perpetual over spot on one completed five-minute auction and fades leverage amplification. It uses no high/low geometry, volume, flow, basis level, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing perpetual 24-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular same-direction cross-market displacement-amplification onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.market_bars: five exact coherent native one-minute BTCUSDT perpetual and spot rows [D-5m,D)
features.excess_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.995
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full directional amplification true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed bars and causal ranks are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent leverage amplification of confirmed cash displacement

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no market, bar, return, magnitude excess, rank history, rank threshold, confirmation, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
